title: Modules
intro: Turn on what this meeting uses. A module turned off disappears from the control room, the shared screen and everyone's screen; its settings are kept.
paidIntro: Available with Ronde Team and Enterprise, in the cloud or self-hosted with a license key.

icebreaker.name: Icebreaker
icebreaker.description: A question drawn from a bank to warm up; everyone answers in one line, shown during the intro.

mood.name: Team mood
mood.description: Everyone shares their mood (⛈️ to ☀️), shown anonymously and tracked in the stats.

rating.name: Meeting usefulness
rating.description: At the wrap-up, everyone rates how useful the meeting was, from 1 to 5, anonymously; the average is tracked in the stats.

reactions.name: Reactions and signals
reactions.description: Emoji reactions and signals (too long, louder…) flying across every screen.

hands.name: Raised hands and questions
hands.description: Raise a hand or ask a question during a turn: a questions step follows that turn.

kudos.name: Kudos
kudos.description: Thank a teammate during the meeting; kudos show on every screen and in the minutes.

spotlight.name: Spotlight
spotlight.description: Show a check-in item, a question or a message of your own in large type on the shared screen.

birthdays.name: Birthdays
birthdays.description: The waiting screen celebrates the birthdays of the week (day and month only).

sounds.name: Sounds
sounds.description: Waiting music, cues and a soundboard, played on everyone's screen or on the shared screen.

ambience.name: Seasonal ambience
ambience.description: Holiday and seasonal decorations on the waiting screen.

gitlab.name: GitLab
gitlab.description: Each person's recent issues and merge requests, to import into their check-in.

workflows.name: Notification workflows
workflows.description: Send a notification only when its conditions hold, in your own words, to Slack, Teams, Matrix or email.

aiAssistant.name: AI assistant
aiAssistant.description: Meeting summary and action extraction; bring your own key when self-hosted.

writeBack.name: Issue write-back
writeBack.description: Turn follow-up actions into Jira, Linear, GitLab or GitHub issues, and keep them in sync.

calendarSync.name: Calendar sync
calendarSync.description: Two-way Google, Microsoft 365 and CalDAV sync, with conflict detection.

analytics.name: Workspace analytics
analytics.description: Dashboards across meetings: participation, engagement, recurring blockers.

scheduledReports.name: Scheduled reports
scheduledReports.description: A digest of your meetings by email, every week or month.

rotation.name: Rotating roles
rotation.description: Who facilitates and who takes notes changes at every session, in round-table order.

retro.name: Retrospective
retro.description: Anonymous sticky notes in columns, grouped by the host, voted on by the team, then discussed; add it to the agenda.

timebox.name: Timebox
timebox.description: A topic of its own on the agenda, with its own duration and its notes in the minutes.

poker.name: Planning poker
poker.description: The team estimates items with cards kept hidden until the reveal; add it to the agenda.

polls.name: Polls
polls.description: Ask the team a question during the session: choices, a scale or a word cloud, anonymous or not.

random.name: Random tools
random.description: A wheel to pick who goes next, a random speaking order, random teams, or heads or tails, played on every screen at once.

parking.name: Parking lot
parking.description: Set aside anything off-topic in one click; it becomes an open topic for the next session.

decisions.name: Decision log
decisions.description: Every “Decision:” line of the notes, from every session, in one searchable list open to the whole team.

github.name: GitHub
github.description: Each person's recent issues and pull requests, imported into their check-in in one click.

video.name: Video call
video.description: Join the call from every page: a link to any tool, a Jitsi room or your BigBlueButton server.

async.name: Async mode
async.description: No live session: everyone fills in their check-in and comments, then the digest goes out by email at the planned time.
